lessons.notes: Core concept: Base + Acid + Sweet + Aroma. Common zero-proof bases: tea, juices, soda, non-alcoholic spirits, coconut water. Focus on cocktail structure, not “juice only” builds.

lessons.title: Building Structure Without Alcohol
lessons.notes: Learn to build balance without ethanol: citrus, shrubs/vinegar, tea tannin, and NA bitters. If a mocktail tastes too sweet, first adjust acidity.

lessons.title: Texture & Mouthfeel
lessons.notes: Alcohol adds body, so zero-proof drinks use alternatives: aquafaba/egg white, coconut cream, carbonation, tonic, and saline for palate length and texture.

lessons.title: Zero-Proof Syrups & Cordials
lessons.notes: Layer flavor with ginger, hibiscus, mint, citrus cordials, and honey syrup. Cordials deliver concentrated flavor + sweetness while improving consistency.

lessons.title: Low-ABV vs True Zero
lessons.notes: Low ABV is not non-alcoholic. Low ABV examples: spritz, sherry cocktails, vermouth highballs. True zero includes mocktails and soda-based NA builds.

lessons.title: Mocktail Classics Remixed
lessons.notes: Rebuild classics by structure: Margarita -> lime + agave + soda, Mojito -> mint + lime + soda, Spritz -> orange + tonic. Mimic balance, not alcohol heat.

lessons.title: Pairing Mocktails with Food
lessons.notes: Pairing logic: citrus with seafood, herbal with salads, spiced with BBQ. For spicy food, citrus/ginger mocktails usually perform best.
